Bear Stearns owned ~40% and provided investment management through its Dublin subsidiary. The vehicle held mortgage-backed securities and CLOs. In 2016, Rowan's 'Re-Introduction after Liquid Funding' email subject line confirms Liquid Funding was the shared business context connecting Rowan, Epstein, and Shwachman.

Caterpillar Trust structurally mirrors the 2006 Butterfly Trust but with different trustees. Butterfly Trust (Dec 27, 2006): Grantor=Epstein, Trustees=Indyke+Kahn, Beneficiaries=Kellen+Marcinkova+Maxwell. Caterpillar Trust (Jan 3, 2017): Grantor=Epstein, Trustees=Wallace+Groff (assistants, not lawyers). findings.detail: The Butterfly Trust (EFTA01282018) was a USVI-law irrevocable trust with broad investment and distribution powers. Original beneficiaries: Sarah Kellen, Nada Marcinkova, Ghislaine Maxwell. Later added: Jennifer Kalin and Alina Boiko (March 28, 2011), Susan Hamblin (March 24, 2011). The Caterpillar Trust replaced the principal-level trustees (Indyke/Kahn) with operational staff (Wallace/Groff). Hypothesis: Caterpillar received investment proceeds (e.g., from Blockchain Capital/crypto investments), then fed distributions to Butterfly Trust for onward distribution to beneficiaries.

Unlike Wexner (who surrendered control) or Black (who paid 158M+), Zuckerman repeatedly resisted -- rejecting the structure three times -- but kept re-engaging. The relationship timeline spans 2004-2019, across both pre and post-conviction periods.

findings.summary: In an email to Melanie Spinella (his accountant/assistant), Epstein detailed the Leon Black payment structure: '10m paid today to gratitude america, a 501 c 3, willl make last year complete. 20 million paid today ftc. 10 million july 15 5 million sept 30. , 5 million jan 1 for all of 16. tax savings paid at 37 percent. of net. savings. 50 million credit. net. so 150 million free.' This reveals: (1) the $10M to Gratitude America was part of a larger $35M payment from Black, (2) $20M went to Financial Trust Company (FTC) the same day, (3) Epstein calculated 37% tax savings yielding $50M credit on $150M, and (4) Epstein instructed 'Talk to me before signing anything today important' and 'did the paul weiss bill get paid???'

Dubin invested 4,375,302 USD via Fortress Macro Fund (Oct 2014). Distributions were assigned to JEEPERS INC via Assignment of Economic Interest Agreement dated Aug 1, 2011. Jeepers Inc wired to Bank of New York. Tracked distributions: 222,549 (Oct 2014), 166,911 (Dec 2014), 244,778 (Jun 2015), 183,754 (Dec 2015), 118,050 (Sep 2016), 46,854 (Jun 2017). Government subpoenaed Jeepers Inc demanding organizational structure and relationship to Epstein. FTC (Financial Trust Company) is related entity.

AP SHL Investors LLC was formed by certain Apollo executives to explore investment opportunities that Apollo itself was not pursuing. FTC invested $910,562 in AP SHL during January 2002 and received distributions totaling $384,125, with net investment of $526,437. Per Richard Kahn (June 2014), FTC received K-1s in FTC's name annually. The K-1 was still being sent after FTC's 2012 tax return was filed. Kahn arranged for sale documentation to be communicated to Apollo tax preparer to stop future K-1s. The Dechert LLP investigation (Jan 2021) confirmed AP SHL and AP Technology Partners LLC 'are not Apollo funds and do not have any formal relationship with Apollo, but were formed by certain Apollo executives.'

AP Technology Partners LLC was formed by Apollo executives for investment opportunities outside Apollo. FTC invested $1,311,522 during fiscal year 2000 and received distributions of $82,746, with net investment of $1,228,776. As of 10/31/2012, AP Technology was valued at $2,334,883 to $5,327,051 depending on compounded return rate (5-10%). Epstein requested breakdown of environmental solutions purchases within AP Technology (Sept 2012). Per Dechert LLP memo, AP SHL and AP Technology 'do not have any formal relationship with Apollo, but were formed by certain Apollo executives to explore investment opportunities that Apollo itself was not pursuing.'

Prentice Capital Partners was an FTC K-1 investment showing -$1,618,713 loss in 2009. Harry Beller (FTC's financial manager at JPMorgan/Citadel) contacted Epstein on 3/17/2010 requesting to discuss FTC's investment in Prentice Capital Partners (EFTA02428707). Groff followed up the next day (EFTA02429007). Prentice Capital Management LP is an SEC-registered hedge fund based at 100 West Putnam Avenue, Greenwich CT 06830 (also had NY entity at 181 East 65th Street). Founded by Michael Zimmerman. Filed numerous SC 13G/D with SEC including positions in Blockbuster, Wet Seal, Bluefly, Tweeter, Ascendia Brands, Coconut Palm. BVI entity 'Prentice Capital Management Corporation' appeared in Panama Papers (incorporated 7/26/2002 BVI, reg 506910, defaulted/dissolved 4/30/2009). JPMorgan conducted KYC background searches on Harry Beller including Google searches for allegations (EFTA01297936).

ML Hertz is identified as ML Hertz Co-Investor LP, a Merrill Lynch private equity co-investment vehicle for the 2005 Hertz Global Holdings LBO. SEC Form 4 filings show ML Hertz Co-Investor LP as part of Merrill Lynch's investment chain: Merrill Lynch & Co Inc > Merrill Lynch Group Inc > ML Global Private Equity Partners LP > ML Global Private Equity Fund LP > ML Hertz Co-Investor GP LLC > ML Hertz Co-Investor LP. FTC received only $88 K-1 income from this investment in 2009. Epstein discussed the investment with 'Lisa McAlister from Merrell [Merrill Lynch]' in June-July 2010 (EFTA02411167, EFTA02411200). Groff asked if Darren Indyke should be on the call but was told 'Darren is not on the paperwork and therefore cannot speak on your behalf.' This suggests FTC was a direct limited partner in the Merrill Lynch Hertz LBO co-invest, a position typically reserved for the bank's most valued private wealth clients.

Liquid Funding was an FTC K-1 investment showing minimal $969 income in 2009, but its significance extends beyond the K-1. Marc Rowan (Apollo co-founder) emailed Epstein and Perry Shwachman with subject 'Re-Introduction after Liquid Funding' (EFTA02454291, dated Aug 2016). Shwachman (Partner, Sidley Austin LLP) responded wanting to discuss 'potential new USVI insurance regulations' with Epstein (EFTA02361689). This reveals: (1) Liquid Funding was either an investment vehicle or business context where Rowan, Epstein, and Shwachman previously collaborated; (2) Rowan was actively re-introducing Epstein to new contacts for USVI regulatory influence; (3) Shwachman saw Epstein as having influence over USVI insurance regulation. OCCRP Aleph shows 'Liquid Funding, Ltd.' in ICIJ Paradise Papers (2017) — Bermuda entity (EC 29378) incorporated 10/19/2000 with Irish connection. A separate Liquid Funding LLC was incorporated in NY (2018).

Highbridge/Zwirn was FTC's largest K-1 loss at -$13,302,334 in 2009. Per EFTA02704568: FTC invested $25M on 1/11/2001 and pulled $25M on 2/28/2006. Separately, Haze Trust invested $10M on 5/20/1999 with NO withdrawal. As of May 2014: Southern Financial held $20.4M + Haze Trust $37.9M = $58.3M total in Highbridge. The $13.3M K-1 loss reflects the write-down of the Zwirn fund component after Daniel Zwirn's fund collapsed. DB Zwirn & Co LP sued FTC and Jeepers Inc (disposed 07/23/2010, NY Supreme Court). The Zwirn fund became Fortress Value Recovery Fund I LLC. Richard Kahn confirmed Jeepers received distributions from Fortress Value Recovery (EFTA02349170, June 2015). Epstein was deposed by Susman in the Fortress VERF I LLC vs Jeepers litigation (EFTA02339396, April 2011). Harry Beller forwarded DB Zwirn 2008 audited financial statements from Fortress VRF Investor Relations to Groff (EFTA02445535, Dec 2009). In Aug 2011, someone emailed Epstein: Did you see that Zwirn is starting over with a new fund? (EFTA00917840).

BS Asset Backed Sec. LP (Bear Stearns Asset Backed Securities LP) was an FTC K-1 investment showing -$31,558 loss (+$2,106 adjustment) in 2009. Bear Stearns maintained multiple Epstein accounts: Jeffrey Epstein ($667K cash), Butterfly Trust ($8,044 cash), J. Epstein VI Foundation/Enhanced Education ($4,497,700 cash) per Harry Beller's Sept 2013 confirmation (EFTA02575631). After Bear Stearns collapsed in 2008, Beller asked whether to leave Enhanced Education assets with Ted Serure at Bear Stearns or transfer to First Bank in USVI. Bear Stearns Asset Backed Securities were MBS/ABS securitization trusts — over 10,000 SEC filings exist for various BS ABS trusts. FTC holding a K-1 from BS Asset Backed Sec LP indicates FTC was a limited partner investor in Bear Stearns structured credit products, consistent with the broader pattern of FTC investing through major bank platforms.

Tudor Funding showed -$355,079 K-1 loss in FTC's 2009 tax return (EFTA00725865). Zero results in DOJ Vol 11 text search and LMSBAND. No SEC EDGAR filings under that exact name. The name pattern suggests connection to Tudor Investment Corp (Paul Tudor Jones' hedge fund), possibly a side pocket or feeder fund. Tudor Investment Corp is a major Greenwich CT-based hedge fund. However, no documentary evidence in the Epstein corpus directly links this entity to Paul Tudor Jones or his firm. The -$355K loss is consistent with a write-down of a hedge fund investment during the 2008-2009 financial crisis.

CitiGroup HedgeForum showed -$15,163 K-1 loss in FTC's 2009 tax return (EFTA00725865). Zero results in text search for 'HedgeForum' across all datasets. The Citigroup HedgeForum was likely a Citigroup fund-of-funds or hedge fund access product. Citigroup was active in the Epstein context: Jay P. Lefkowitz of Kirkland & Ellis maintained offices at Citigroup Center, 153 East 53rd Street (EFTA00013538). The FTC K-1 indicates FTC invested in a Citigroup-sponsored hedge fund platform, adding Citigroup to the list of major financial institutions (JPMorgan, Deutsche Bank, Bear Stearns, Merrill Lynch) that provided investment products to Epstein entities.

Jay P. Lefkowitz of Kirkland & Ellis LLP was a key Epstein defense attorney. He represented Epstein in the 2007-2008 federal plea negotiations alongside Ken Starr and Lilly Ann Sanchez. The DOJ sent the plea deal letter to Lefkowitz at Kirkland & Ellis, Citigroup Center, 153 East 53rd Street on 12/11/2007 (EFTA00013538). Lefkowitz and Starr met with the US Attorney to argue against prosecution. Investigatively, Lefkowitz also appears in the DB Zwirn / Jeepers financial litigation context: EFTA01300517 discusses DB Zwirn's corporate structure (dsam was LP of DB Zwirn & Co LP, member of DB Zwirn Partners LLC general partner, and member of DBZ GP LLC managing member). The overlap between Lefkowitz as Epstein's criminal defense attorney and the financial litigation involving FTC/Jeepers investments suggests Kirkland & Ellis may have handled both Epstein's legal defense and his investment dispute litigation, creating potential conflict-of-interest questions.

Harry Beller was FTC's financial controller/manager, handling investment reporting, wire authority, K-1 coordination, and bank account management across JPMorgan, Deutsche Bank, Bear Stearns, and First Bank. Beller managed Haze Trust, Jeepers, Southern Trust Co, and Southern Financial LLC wire authority together (EFTA02575944). He forwarded DB Zwirn/Fortress VRF audited financials to Groff (EFTA02445535). He contacted Epstein directly about Prentice Capital investment (EFTA02428707). He confirmed Bear Stearns account balances including $4.5M Enhanced Education (EFTA02575631). JPMorgan conducted KYC background checks on Beller including Google searches for 'Harry Beller AND allegation OR arrest OR bribe' (EFTA01297936, EFTA01298723). Beller was associated with Citadel form types in JPMorgan systems (EFTA01480167). Beller's role as financial controller means he would have had visibility across all FTC K-1 investments and the full investment portfolio structure.

Marc Rowan (Apollo Global co-founder) personally introduced Epstein to Perry Shwachman (Partner, Sidley Austin LLP) in the context of 'Liquid Funding' (EFTA02454291, Aug 2016). Rowan wrote: 'I will leave it to the two of you to discuss directly.' Shwachman then contacted Epstein about 'potential new USVI insurance regulations' (EFTA02361689, Aug 2016). This reveals Rowan was actively brokering connections for Epstein well after Epstein's 2008 conviction. The 'Liquid Funding' context appears on FTC's 2009 K-1, suggesting a shared investment history. Separately, the Dechert LLP memo (EFTA02730996) commissioned by Apollo Conflicts Committee investigated the Epstein/Black relationship and confirmed AP SHL and AP Technology were formed by 'certain Apollo executives' — Rowan, as co-founder, would have known about these side vehicles. Rowan's introduction of Shwachman to Epstein for USVI regulatory influence echoes the broader pattern of Apollo executives facilitating Epstein's access to institutional power.

Distinguished from Financial Trust Company Inc (FTC) which was a USVI S Corp. The C Corp vs S Corp distinction suggests FT Real Estate had different tax treatment, possibly for holding property assets with foreign investors or multiple classes of stock.

Stern told Epstein they 'can use the Asia Gateway UK entity but can not use the Asia Gateway name or logo (its part of my deal with Informa plc)' (Jan 2011, EFTA01833114). This reveals: Epstein was structuring Asia Gateway to (1) maintain JPMorgan relationship while (2) managing Chinese business risk through a separate entity facade. 439 DugganUSA references. Stern was the David Stern identified as FTC joint venture partner and Prince Andrew intermediary.

Southern Country International Ltd was a USVI entity at 6100 Red Hook Quarter B3 St Thomas (standard Epstein USVI address). Richard Kahn and Alan Dlugash (Epstein accountant) discussed the entity IRS Form 1120 business activity code in Sep 2015 (EFTA02488862). Dlugash recommended code 525990 (Other Financial Vehicles) over International Banking Entity language to avoid triggering an IRS task force audit. FTC used 523900 (Other Financial Investment Activities). The entity received a M check and a ,738 check from HBRK Associates Neptune LLC account on Nov 25 2019 (EFTA01270954), months after Epstein's death. This suggests Southern Country International was an active Epstein investment vehicle managed by Kahn/HBRK that continued operating post-mortem as part of estate administration.

David Stern (identified in Wave 4 as FTC='JPM joint venture'/Prince Andrew intermediary) wrote to Epstein on Sep 6 2011: 'I am going with PA to China on 23 October (Shanghai, Guangzhou, Shenzhen, Hong Kong), then private weekend in Zheijiang, then two days in Kuala Lumpur. Most meetings by now are organised by me except mayors and governors and nothing in KL. I stay in the background/hidden, just make the arrangements.' PA = Prince Andrew. This confirms Stern was organizing Prince Andrew's Malaysia/China itinerary while deliberately staying 'background/hidden' -- classic intelligence tradecraft. Three copies of this email exist (EFTA02693853, EFTA02367886, EFTA02543035), confirming its significance. Stern had KL contacts and organized high-level meetings, connecting the Epstein network to Malaysian political infrastructure.

David Stern (FTC) Tokyo-SoftBank meeting identified: On Jun 12, 2018, Stern emailed Epstein: 'Going to Tokyo tomorrow to meet Softbank COO (former Sprint Chairman).' This is Marcelo Claure, confirmed as COO of SoftBank Group on the FII 2018 speaker list (EFTA02603142). Claure's dual role at SoftBank and Sprint, plus his Tokyo meetings, place him at the intersection of Japanese corporate power. Five months later (Nov 19, 2018), Ghosn was arrested in Tokyo. Stern's Tokyo-SoftBank connection is a candidate pathway for Epstein's rapid Ghosn intelligence gathering. Stern also discussed 'EV develops well' in the same email and asked about North Korea access through US channels, demonstrating his intelligence/business broker role in Asia.

AP SHL Investors LLC was a side vehicle formed by certain Apollo executives to explore investment opportunities that Apollo chose not to pursue. Per Dechert LLP investigation (Exhibit 99.1, Apollo 8-K Jan 2021): 'Financial Trust Company invested in two other entities, AP SHL Investors LLC and AP Technology Partners LLC, which are not Apollo funds and do not have any formal relationship with Apollo, but were formed by certain Apollo executives to explore investment opportunities that Apollo chose not to pursue.' FTC invested $910,562 in Jan 2002, received $384,125 in distributions, net investment $526,437. K-1 loss of -$200 on 2009 return. Sale was reported in FTC 2012 tax return as long-term capital gain write-off, but Apollo tax preparer not notified, resulting in continued K-1 issuance through at least 2013.

AP Technology Partners LLC was a side vehicle formed by certain Apollo executives (separate from Apollo funds, per Dechert LLP investigation). FTC invested $1,311,522 during fiscal year 2000 in multiple tranches ($525K Mar, $175K Apr, $117K-$137K Jun-Nov), received $82,746 in distributions, net investment $1,228,776. K-1 showed $18,938 income on 2009 return. Still held at $250K-$111K carrying value through 2015 in Leon Black/FTC balance sheets. Black Family Partners (BFP) records show AP Technology was owned by LDB (Leon D. Black), not BFP. Managed alongside FTC investments by Harry Beller, with K-1s received annually.

Tudor Futures Fund is a managed futures fund (SEC CIK 870088) managed by Tudor Investment Corporation, founded by Paul Tudor Jones. Registered at c/o Tudor Investment Corporation, 1275 King Street, Greenwich, CT 06831. FTC held significant positions: $16.3M as of 4/30/12, $13.6M as of 3/31/13, declining to $13.5M by 7/31/14. Listed on K-1 as 'Tudor Funding' with -$355,079 loss on 2009 return. Fully redeemed August 2014 ($13,501,622 Tudor Redemption shown in 8/31/14 valuation report). Wire transfers show Southern Financial LLC (USVI entity, 6100 Red Hook Quarter B3, St Thomas) wiring funds to Tudor Futures Fund at Harborside Plaza 10, 3 Second Street, Jersey City via JPMorgan Chase Bank NA. This confirms Epstein invested in a Paul Tudor Jones vehicle through FTC/Southern Financial.

Prentice Capital Partners (K-1 name: 'Prentice Partners') is a hedge fund managed by Prentice Capital Management LP, founded in 2005 by Michael Zimmerman (ex-SAC Capital). Registered at 181 East 65th St, Apt 19A, New York, NY 10021 (per NY SoS). SEC Adviser #161178. K-1 showed -$1,618,713 loss on FTC 2009 return (the largest individual entity loss after Highbridge/Zwirn). Harry Beller discussed FTC's investment with Epstein on 3/17/2010 (EFTA02428707), and Groff forwarded to Epstein the next day (EFTA02429007). The firm specializes in long/short equity with focus on US commercial/retail sectors. A 2007 LMSBAND document (EFTA01329067) references 'Prentice' in a 2007 context, suggesting investment predates the K-1 period.

ML Hertz Co-Investor LP is a Merrill Lynch private equity co-investment vehicle (427 SEC EDGAR filings) that co-invested in the 2005 leveraged buyout of Hertz Corporation alongside Clayton Dubilier & Rice, Carlyle Group, and Merrill Lynch Global Private Equity. The fund structure: ML Hertz Co-Investor GP LLC (general partner) -> ML Hertz Co-Investor LP -> Hertz Global Holdings Inc (HRI). K-1 showed negligible $88 income on FTC 2009 return. FTC portfolio summary (4/30/12) lists ML HERTZ at $3.87-3.97M. Lisa McAlister from 'Merrell' (likely Merrill Lynch) arranged a call with Epstein re ML Hertz investment in June-July 2010 (EFTA02411167). Indyke was NOT on the paperwork for this investment. This confirms Epstein had a direct private equity co-investment position in Hertz via Merrill Lynch's PE platform.

CitiGroup HedgeForum was Citi Private Bank's hedge fund-of-funds platform that vetted hedge fund managers and acted as a conduit for client investments. HedgeForum managed $2.9B in client assets as of mid-2010, growing to $5.25B by 2017. 520 SEC EDGAR filings show dozens of HedgeForum sub-funds (HedgeForum GoldenTree, HedgeForum Third Point, HedgeForum Renaissance Equities, HedgeForum Caxton, HedgeForum CFM, HedgeForum Pentwater, etc.). Parent entity: Citigroup Alternative Investments Multi Adv Hedge Fu Por LLC. K-1 showed -$15,163 loss on FTC 2009 return. This was a standard institutional hedge fund access product for high-net-worth clients ($25M+ minimum). The small loss amount suggests a minor allocation, likely a diversification holding rather than a core position.

BS Asset Backed Sec. LP (K-1 abbreviation) refers to a Bear Stearns asset-backed securities fund. Bear Stearns Asset Backed Securities I LLC (BSABSI, SEC CIK 1331678) was the primary issuer of mortgage pass-through certificates. K-1 showed -$31,558 loss on FTC 2009 return. FTC portfolio summaries (4/30/12, 4/30/13) consistently list 'BEAR STEARNS Asset Backed Securities' at $331,882 (7/31/09 valuation, frozen). Monthly reconciliations show small cash distributions continuing: 'cash received BSABS' of $17,622 (4/30/12) and $12,224 (4/30/13), indicating residual payments from the securitization trust winding down. After Bear Stearns collapse in March 2008 and JPMorgan acquisition, these positions transitioned to 'JPM (formerly Bear Stearns)' in FTC books. Position held under JPM (Bear Stearns) brokerage account alongside $666K in other BS positions and $8K Butterfly Trust.

Liquid Funding appears as both a K-1 partner ($969 income on FTC 2009 return) and a topic connecting Marc Rowan (Apollo co-founder) to Epstein. A December 2004 FTC investment summary lists 'Liquid Funding Holding' alongside AP SHL Investors, Tudor Futures Fund, and other K-1 entities (EFTA01308282). In August 2016, Marc Rowan emailed Perry Shwachman (Partner, Sidley Austin LLP) and Epstein with subject line 'Re-Introduction after Liquid Funding' (EFTA02361689/EFTA02454291), suggesting Rowan and Epstein previously worked together on Liquid Funding and Rowan was re-introducing Shwachman to Epstein for USVI insurance regulation work. An ICIJ Paradise Papers entry shows 'Liquid Funding, Ltd.' (EC 29378) incorporated 10/19/2000 in Bermuda with Irish connections. The negligible K-1 amount ($969) and 'Holding' suffix suggest this was a dormant or legacy holding by 2009.

Highbridge/Zwirn K-1 represents a combined -$13,302,334 loss on FTC 2009 return, dominating the K-1 schedule. This encompasses two distinct disputes: (1) HIGHBRIDGE CAPITAL: Founded by Glenn Dubin (close Epstein associate, dated Eva Andersson-Dubin). FTC invested $25,044,521 on 1/11/2001, withdrew $25M on 2/28/2006. Haze Trust invested $10,041,666 on 5/20/1999 with no withdrawal. As of May 2014: Southern Financial $20.5M + Haze Trust $37.9M = $58.4M total Highbridge exposure. Epstein was listed as adviser on JPM-Highbridge deal alongside Goldman Sachs (undisclosed). Highbridge Multistrategy fully redeemed Feb 2015 (final payments: Haze $113,297, SFL $62,943). (2) DB ZWIRN: Daniel Zwirn used $2.7M from Highbridge managed account in Dec 2004 to purchase an airplane without disclosure. Epstein's oral redemption request was Oct 2006, written Nov 13 2006. JAMS Arbitration (Ref 1425006537): Fortress VRF I LLC vs Jeepers Inc, with FTC and Jeepers as counter-claimants vs DB Zwirn entities and Daniel Zwirn personally. Depositions: Epstein, Zwirn, Dubin, Beller. Hearing July 22-29 2011. Zwirn fund became Fortress Value Recovery Fund I LLC under Fortress Investment Group management. The $13.3M K-1 loss primarily reflects the Zwirn write-down, with Epstein pursuing $76M settlement against CdZ/JPM.

Lutnick and Epstein shared extensive overlapping social circles documented in DOJ files: (1) Glenn and Eva Dubin: Lutnick and Allison were benefit co-chairs for the Dubin Breast Center alongside the Dubins in both 2012 and 2013 (EFTA02702727, EFTA02672763). findings.detail: FBME North American Client Screening Committee assigned RAC score of 8 (high-risk) on Nov 17, 2005. Justification for continuing: USA PATRIOT Act and EU Money Laundering Directive limited FBME ability to launder, and Central Bank of Cyprus vouched for FBME as excellent on KYC/AML. In Jan 2007, AML COMPLIANCE DIRECTOR-1 and DB Greece executives met FBME in Cyprus. DB provided annual AML workshops for Cypriot clients including FBME starting June 2010. findings.summary: AML COMPLIANCE DIRECTOR-1 drafted internal memo on November 6, 2013 concluding 'basis for closure' of Danske Estonia accounts due to lack of AML improvement. Memo was never sent to any other DB personnel or third party prior to account closure in October 2015. Two days later on Nov 8, 2013, US AFC officers discussed concerns on call with German colleagues — Danske Estonia described as 'not cooperative enough' and had 'not improved.' AML COMPLIANCE DIRECTOR-1 then advocated maintaining relationship while mitigating risks.
findings.detail: By early 2014, other major Western financial institutions were de-risking the Baltic region. DB elected to continue. In Sept 2014 transition memo, AML COMPLIANCE DIRECTOR-1 stated: the Baltics suffer from an inherently high client AML risk. Continued monitoring should be placed on Danske Bank Estonia. If the situation worsens, I recommend that the account be closed. Despite this recommendation, DB continued relationship. DB maintained Danske Estonia because: (1) it was viewed as important component of global relationship with Danske Bank A/S, and (2) DB believed it could effectively mitigate and control the risks. findings.summary: Reid Weingarten (Epstein defense attorney, Steptoe and Johnson) made only 3 personal political donations totaling 3000 dollars: 1000 to Strickland for Colorado (2002), 1000 to Alex Sanders for Senate (2002), 1000 to Friends of Mark Warner (1996). All from Washington DC. Minimal political donor despite being a high-profile white-collar defense attorney. No coordination with other Epstein network donors detected.

Kenneth Starr appears as a registered lobbyist (ID 34088) at Kirkland and Ellis LLP. However, his known lobbying of Congress on behalf of Epstein (documented in investigation records, including op-ed drafts, Baylor warnings, and Congressional contacts during the 2007-2008 NPA period) does NOT appear in LDA filings under his name at Kirkland and Ellis. Starr's Congressional lobbying for Epstein appears to have been conducted outside the formal LDA registration framework. This is consistent with legal counsel providing 'advice' rather than registered lobbying contacts, but the documented Congressional outreach on Epstein's behalf raises questions about LDA compliance.

Starr's relationship with Epstein spans at minimum 2007-2019. Key timeline: 2007-2008 Starr was part of Epstein's NPA defense team at Kirkland & Ellis (alongside Dershowitz, Lefkowitz, Lefcourt); July 2009 Starr called Epstein 'my admired friend' from Tel Aviv teaching at Bar Ilan; 2010 arranged Harvard dinner with Henry Rosovsky; 2016-2017 JASTA legislative strategy; Nov 2017-Mar 2019 intensive op-ed and AG/Mueller strategy. Jan 2018 Starr confirmed writing a book for Penguin Random House ('Contempt: A Memoir of the Clinton Investigation') with Epstein's advice on marketing.

DECHERT REPORT CONTRADICTIONS AND SCOPE GAPS (SEC 8-K EX-99.1/EX-99.2): The Dechert report, while being the most comprehensive public investigation of the Black-Epstein relationship, contains significant contradictions and scope limitations: (1) CONTRADICTION -- 'never did any business': Dechert acknowledged FTC purchased 263,257 Apollo IPO shares, FTC invested in AP SHL ($910K) and AP Technology Partners ($1.3M) formed by 'certain Apollo executives,' and FTC invested in ESWW alongside Black. Yet the report upheld Apollo's statement it 'never did any business with' Epstein, noting the phrases are 'perhaps more nuanced than might appear at first glance.' (2) CONTRADICTION -- 'neither co-founder hired Epstein': Documentary evidence (EFTA02670537) shows Paul Weiss was writing IRS Form 8865 filings for 'all three guys.' (3) SCOPE GAP: Document collection from Apollo employees' work email would not capture Harris-Bodian-Epstein communications routed through personal email (jeevacation@gmail.com) and Mintz Levin accounts. (4) SCOPE GAP: Paul Weiss 'assisted in document collection' while Brad Karp (PW chairman) was forwarding confidential tax correspondence to Epstein -- creating a conflict of interest in the investigation it was assisting. (5) ESWW: Dechert confirmed FTC invested in Environmental Solutions World Wide alongside Black and Black family members in 2011 -- another direct business overlap.

Weingarten told a third party 'don't mention my role with brad till we both think it useful' -- referring to Brad Karp (Paul Weiss chairman). This suggests Weingarten had a confidential advisory role related to Karp and Epstein that was strategically concealed. Weingarten also told Epstein: 'Still have to figure out what my role is in all this shit.' In Sept 2011, Epstein told Matthew Menchel (Kobre & Kim LLP attorney): 'your name just came up, when you sent an email to weingarten, he is with me in paris love to see you' -- confirming Weingarten traveled with Epstein internationally.

EFTA00925685 (Dec 9, 2011): Weingarten to Epstein: 'Got back last nite...kiev is pretty wild...need to be in dc monday morn first thing.' Weingarten had just returned from Kiev, Ukraine in Dec 2011 — during a period of significant US legal interest in Ukraine (Tymoshenko trial Oct 2011, Manafort active, Pinchuk dealings). This is 8 years before Weingarten's SoftBank involvement and connects to the broader Ukraine thread (Schoen FARA #6071 for Pinchuk, Waldman dual Deripaska/Lavrov registration). Weingarten also referenced 'interesting jeffrey-reid projects' — confirming joint ventures beyond attorney-client.

DECHERT PAYMENT TIMELINE DISCREPANCY: The Dechert report states Black's payments totaled 158M from 2013-2017. The annual breakdown: 2013 (50M) + 2014 (70M) + 2015 (30M) + 2017 (8M) = 158M. However, within 2013, Dechert describes two separate agreements: (1) First agreement (signed Feb 13, 2013): 23.5M (15M Feb + 8.5M Oct) for GRAT work. (2) Second agreement (negotiated May 2013, never signed): 56.5M in five installments over 2013-2014, renegotiated in early 2014. Black made first two installments in 2013 totaling 26.5M. Total 2013 = 23.5M + 26.5M = 50M. The 2014 amount of 70M included 20M attributed to the step-up basis transaction. The step-up basis transaction later became the central fee dispute: Epstein demanded 60M (10% of 600M perceived benefit), Black paid only 20M. This dispute ultimately destroyed the relationship. The Dechert report explicitly notes Black erroneously believed payments were tax-deductible (sixty cent dollars) based on Epstein's misrepresentation.

Brad Karp's family engagement with Epstein extended well beyond professional legal services. Both children (David and Meredith) are named in Epstein documents. David attended a Woody Allen screening at age ~18 (May 2014), dined with Epstein and met Woody Allen in person (Jan 2016), and had Epstein arrange meetings with Woody Allen's assistant Helen Robin (Aug 2016). Karp brought his son's girlfriend Courtney Loo to Epstein screenings (Jan 2018). Karp shared his daughter's medical emergency with Epstein. Epstein created a personalized gift for David (having Woody write out answers to David's questions). The 'coming solo' email (July 2015) implies wife Robbie sometimes attended Epstein events. This is ethically extraordinary: the perpetrator mediating between his victims' lawyer and his former defense counsel (Dershowitz), who were in defamation litigation against each other.

DECHERT REPORT PAYMENT TIMELINE CONFIRMED (SEC 8-K EX-99.1, Jan 25 2021): The Dechert LLP independent investigation, filed as Apollo 8-K exhibit, confirms Black paid Epstein $158M total (2013-2017) via Southern Trust Company Inc: (1) Feb 15, 2013: $15M first installment per signed service agreement. FTC APOLLO IPO DIRECTED SHARE OFFERING -- AUTHORIZATION CHAIN: Dechert confirms FTC purchased 263,257 Apollo shares during March 2011 IPO via a 'directed share offering program managed by the lead broker-dealer.' Directed share programs (DSPs) in IPOs are allocation programs where the issuer designates specific purchasers who receive shares at the IPO price before public trading. For an allocation of 263,257 shares (~$5M at ~$19/share), the issuer's management or underwriting syndicate lead must approve the allocation. This means someone at Apollo or the lead underwriter (Goldman Sachs/JPMorgan were Apollo's IPO leads) authorized FTC's participation. Black told Dechert he 'did not recall that transaction almost a decade later.' The shares were transferred to Southern Financial LLC in 2013 and held through at least September 2019. Dechert acknowledged this contradicts Apollo's public statement that it 'never did any business with' Epstein, noting the phrases are 'quite broad in scope' and 'perhaps more nuanced than might appear at first glance.' The FTC IPO purchase is significant because (1) it confirms a direct financial relationship between an Epstein entity and Apollo corporate structure, (2) someone at Apollo authorized the allocation, and (3) Southern Financial LLC held the shares through Epstein's arrest.

findings.detail: Gawker v. FBI (M.D. Fla. 8:15-cv-01202, Judge Susan Bucklew, filed 2015). After 2012 FBI sting targeting Keith Davidson, US Attorneys office declined to prosecute. FBI accumulated 1168 responsive documents and 2 CDs of video from investigation. Gawker filed FOIA Nov 2013 seeking evidence for defense in Hogan suit. FBI refused Jan 2015 claiming ongoing investigation. Gawker sued. FBI tried to withhold entire file under 7A. Judge ordered production but upheld: Exemption 5 (attorney-client), Exemption 7E (law enforcement techniques - documents stayed withheld). Partially denied 6 and 7C privacy claims, ordered names unredacted for public figures. 1168 documents is unusually large for a sex tape theft-extortion case suggesting investigation went beyond Davidson sting. 7E exemption (law enforcement techniques) is unusual for this type of case. Subject to Deutsche Bank AML/KYC review (KYC 1790748, account opened Oct 16 2013, closed by Apr 2019). Held ,824 cash at Deutsche Bank as of Aug 31 2014. Karyna Shuliak was Joint Account Holder and Authorized Signor. Richard Kahn at HBRK Associates managed the account (575 Lexington Ave 4th Fl). Property maintenance emails show Neptune LLC used for Palm Beach construction bids, punch lists, and door replacements (Leighton Allenby as Director of Properties). The FL Neptune entities (#151-153) discovered via phone pivot are UNRELATED to this USVI Neptune LLC - they are separate Florida companies that happen to appear in the same Bureau van Dijk results.

Richard Kahn forwarded an article about the company being sold at discount (EFTA02632096). This was a legitimate service not a shell company. Wire payment likely represents membership fees.

Poplar Inc. banking connected to Banco Popular de Puerto Rico via Andrew Farkas. On March 6 2019, Richard Kahn emailed Epstein a reminder to open new accounts at Banco Popular in connection with Farkas (EFTA02631399). Same day, Epstein emailed Andrew L. Farkas asking him to get a contact at the local Banco Popular from Richard Carion (likely Richard Carrion, former CEO of Banco Popular de Puerto Rico) saying he wanted to move more business to them (EFTA02632600). On March 18 2019, Epstein emailed Farkas about the Banco Popular decision noting that owning AYH would have been a potential issue re banks and that VI government was gung ho on op zone (EFTA02637274). AYH appears to be a USVI entity or investment. The Banco Popular connection to Poplar Inc is confirmed via First Bank PR account statements already documented and the Kahn-Farkas-Carion banking channel.

Southern Country International Ltd was a USVI entity at 6100 Red Hook Quarter B3 St Thomas (standard Epstein USVI address). Richard Kahn and Alan Dlugash (Epstein accountant) discussed the entity IRS Form 1120 business activity code in Sep 2015 (EFTA02488862). Dlugash recommended code 525990 (Other Financial Vehicles) over International Banking Entity language to avoid triggering an IRS task force audit. FTC used 523900 (Other Financial Investment Activities). The entity received a M check and a ,738 check from HBRK Associates Neptune LLC account on Nov 25 2019 (EFTA01270954), months after Epstein's death. This suggests Southern Country International was an active Epstein investment vehicle managed by Kahn/HBRK that continued operating post-mortem as part of estate administration.

Andrew Farkas of Island Global Yachting (717 Fifth Avenue 18th Floor NYC) owned and operated American Yacht Harbor (AYH) in St Thomas USVI where Epstein was a tenant. Kahn simultaneously reminded Epstein to open new Banco Popular accounts connected to Farkas (EFTA02631399). Richard Kahn forwarded a Senate Intelligence Committee article about Bannon being grilled about Cambridge Analytica to Epstein (EFTA02610736, Dec 6, 2018).

Richard Kahn (HBRK Associates, Epstein's financial manager) forwarded BAML research note to Epstein on Jun 14, 2018 -- five months before Ghosn's arrest -- containing a RENAULT SPECIAL SITUATIONS BUY recommendation: 'High conviction from BAML Special Sits in London. Risk-reward now asymmetric. Market currently pricing in NEAR ZERO probability of merger with Nissan. WE SAY: CEO's start/stop narrative on the merger has wiped out the perceived optionality. This is posturing for the deal. Renault needs the deal to unlock its punitive HoldCo discount. Nissan needs it as well.' Epstein replied to Kahn AND Paul Barrett: 'same advice to the butcher in columbus Ohio --- silly.' Epstein was thus tracking the Renault-Nissan merger dynamics as a FINANCIAL OPPORTUNITY months before Ghosn's arrest disrupted the merger permanently.

'CEO's start/stop narrative on the merger has wiped out the perceived optionality.' This investment research was received by Epstein 5 months before Ghosn's arrest and during period of active Epstein-Karp contact. The Renault-Nissan merger question was central to the politics behind Ghosn's arrest.

Cambridge Analytica appears in 6 DOJ Vol 11 documents and 10 Unified DB docs. All references are in the context of Steve Bannon's political activities -- news articles about Bannon's European populist movement shared in Bannon-Epstein correspondence (Jul 2018) and a Daily Beast article about the Senate Intelligence Committee grilling Bannon about Cambridge Analytica forwarded by Richard Kahn to Epstein (Dec 6 2018, EFTA02610736). ZERO hits for Giannakopoulos, SCL Geneva, or any direct Cambridge Analytica business references. The Cambridge Analytica mentions are entirely about Bannon's known public role, not about SCL's intelligence operations, election interference contracts, or Swiss operations.

KPMG forensic review (Dec 18, 2020) confirmed exactly 5 donations to IPI totaling $650,000 from Epstein-controlled entities between 2010-2020: (1) Enhanced Education $125,000 on Oct 11, 2011 for 'WK Rick Hooper fellowship'; (2) Gratitude America $150,000 on May 8, 2017 labeled 'Reimbursement of tickets to the Oslo Play'; (3) Gratitude America $125,000 on Jun 12, 2017; (4) Gratitude America $100,000 on Nov 1, 2017 labeled 'Contribution from Gatitude [sic] America, LTD Oslo Play'; (5) Gratitude America $150,000 on Apr 5, 2019 (3 months before arrest). KPMG also found one flight reimbursement of $14,158.88 from Enhanced Education on Mar 28, 2014 for 'L. Summers flight'. Total Epstein-related financial flow through IPI: $664,158.88.

The 'Oslo Play' was used as justification for $250,000 in payments from Gratitude America to IPI in 2017. Two checks totaling $250K: $150K on May 8, 2017 ('Reimbursement of tickets to the Oslo Play') and $100K on Nov 1, 2017 ('Contribution from Gatitude America, LTD Oslo Play'). The Broadway play 'Oslo' by J.T. Rogers premiered at Lincoln Center in June 2016 and transferred to Broadway in April 2017. Rod-Larsen hosted a private cocktail reception before a May 5, 2017 performance (EFTA02650430). Epstein 'hired out the entire theatre for the U.N.' (EFTA02650158). However, $250K for theater tickets is wildly disproportionate. KPMG noted no donor restrictions on these contributions, meaning IPI could use the funds for any purpose. This pattern suggests the 'Oslo Play' label may have been a pretext for unrestricted charitable donations.

Leon Black donated $200,000 to IPI in December 2014. The donation letter (EFTA02705181) from Black at 760 Park Avenue was addressed to 'Terje Rod-Larsen, President, International Peace Institute, Inc., 777 United Nations Plaza 4th Floor, New York, NY 10017-3521.' This donation was separate from Black's $10M to Gratitude America (Oct 2015), which subsequently made its own donations to IPI. On April 4, 2019, Klein emailed Camilla Reksten-Monsen (Rod-Larsen's special assistant at IPI) requesting IPI bank instructions and 501c3 certification. Reksten-Monsen provided IPI's JPMorgan Chase account details. Klein responded: 'I will send check tomorrow AM' to IPI's offices at 777 UN Plaza (EFTA02282103). Klein preferred to 'send an overnight check or deliver check via messenger' rather than wire (EFTA02280923). This was the last Epstein-related donation to IPI. The timing -- April 2019, with SDNY investigation already underway -- raises questions about whether this was a final disbursement before anticipated legal proceedings.

Checks: EFTA01357084 (May 8 2017, 150K), EFTA01360128 (Jun 12 2017, 125K), EFTA01362195 (Nov 1 2017, 100K). Epstein constructed a comprehensive Norwegian power network spanning: (1) DIPLOMACY: Rod-Larsen (IPI head, UN Coordinator) + Mona Juul (Ambassador); (2) POLITICS: Jagland (PM, Nobel Chairman, CoE SG); (3) FINANCE/INDUSTRY: Morits Skaugen (shipping magnate); (4) GLOBAL GOVERNANCE: Borge Brende (WEF President, FM); (5) LEGAL: Kare Moljord (Supreme Court lawyer). As of Feb 2026, Norwegian state response includes: Juul charged with gross corruption, Rod-Larsen with aiding, Jagland investigated for aggravated corruption, WEF probing Brende, Moljord resigned from government board, Crown Princess Mette-Marit also implicated.

Debra and Leon Black Family Foundation (EIN 13-3947890) at 445 Park Ave, c/o Elysium. Black Family Foundation grant timing analysis: 2011 K grants, 2012 M grants, 2013 .5M grants, 2014 .76M grants (SPIKE - 10x increase), 2015 .93M grants, 2019 .81M grants. The 2014 spike to .76M in grants paid is extraordinary. Since Gratitude America received .003M in its 2015 tax year, and the Black Foundation paid .76M in its 2014 tax year, the timing aligns with a late-2014 or early-2015 transfer. The M Gratitude America contribution was approximately 85% of the Black Foundation total 2014 grants.

LOBBYING FOOTPRINT SYNTHESIS: The Epstein network shows a distinctive pattern of influence outside formal lobbying channels. Key findings: (1) ZERO LDA filings for Epstein personally, IPI, HDI, Gratitude America, Enhanced Education, Leon Black Foundation, or any Epstein-named entity. (2) Apollo Global (Leon Black) spent 1.21M on lobbying in 2019 (278% increase from 2018), with Q4 2019 alone at 670K. (3) Deutsche Bank lobbied on AML regulation in 2007 while maintaining 40+ Epstein accounts. (4) Ken Starr was registered at Kirkland Ellis but Epstein lobbying appears unregistered. (5) Carbyne (Barak) lobbied actively 2021-2025 on Next Gen 911. (6) L Brands (Wexner) had 784 filings with massive political contributions. (7) IPI and HDI zero-filing status despite 33+ Congress members is the most significant red flag - potential LDA violations. (8) See Forever Foundation (Weingarten) used Squire Patton Boggs with Clinton-era lobbyist Rodney Slater. Pattern: Epstein's influence was deliberately structured to avoid lobbying disclosure requirements, operating through nonprofits, personal relationships, and legal counsel rather than registered lobbying contacts.

Leon Black operated TWO foundations at the same 445 Park Ave address c/o Elysium: (1) Debra and Leon Black Family Foundation (EIN 13-3947890) - large pass-through grants vehicle, and (2) Leon D. Black Foundation (EIN 20-5117734) - smaller arts/culture foundation. Combined grant-making: Family Foundation paid .76M in 2014, .93M in 2015, .81M in 2019, then essentially ceased. Leon D. Black Foundation continued at K-.6M/yr through 2023. The Family Foundation was the vehicle for the M Gratitude America transfer and is now nearly depleted (K assets). The personal foundation continues. This dual structure provided layered opacity for different scales of giving.

FEC analysis reveals ZERO donations from employees of Gratitude America, Enhanced Education, DKIP, or Financial Trust Company. These core Epstein entities had no political footprint via employer-based donations. The ONLY Epstein entities appearing in FEC employer fields are: J Epstein and Company/Epstein and Company Inc (Jeffrey's donations 1994-2000), New York Strategy Group (Indyke, Groff, Schantz), Ossa Properties (Barrett, Mark Epstein), and RDK Properties (Kahn). The absence of donations from Gratitude America employees is notable given its M endowment from Leon Black.

February 1-2, 2017 was the HIGHEST-VOLUME single date cluster in the DS10 dataset, with over $52M in outgoing transactions across multiple entities in 48 hours. DETAILED BREAKDOWN: Feb 1: Plan D LLC $46,300,000 to Bank of America (EFTA01296638), Plan D LLC $1,000,000 to Bank of America (EFTA01286637), FT Real Estate $1,500,000 self-transfer (EFTA00), FT Real Estate $1,500,000 incoming from unknown (EFTA00130829). Feb 2: FT Real Estate $280,000 outgoing to unknown. The $47.3M Plan D outflow to Bank of America on a single day represents the single largest daily flow in the entire dataset. This concentration on Feb 1 is followed by: Feb 21 — $15K wire from Gratitude America to Coutts & Co. A/C PETER FENWICK (British neuropsychiatrist, consciousness research grant), Feb 27 — $20,011,000 UNKNOWN entity internal transfer plus Plan D $116.7K, LSJE operational payments. The Feb 2017 total monthly outflow exceeds $70M. This month marks the transition: STC balance had dropped from peak to $18M (May 2017), Plan D was draining its BV70 loan proceeds, and the entire DB relationship was winding down. DB compliance was simultaneously questioning the BV70 incoming wire (EFTA02654334).

DS10 records a $15,000 wire on February 21, 2017 from GRATITUDE AMERICA, LTD to COUTTS AND CO. A/C PETER FENWICK (EFTA01296855). Peter Fenwick is a British neuropsychiatrist known for consciousness and near-death experience research. Multiple Epstein-Fenwick emails confirm the relationship: EFTA02343953 (Oct 2017 NYC visit), EFTA02348505 (Apr 2017 grant administration discussion with options including 'the Network' educational trust and La Laguna). The payment was a scientific research grant routed through Gratitude America, Epstein's Leon Black-funded charity vehicle at Deutsche Bank. The Gratitude America statement (EFTA01296855) also shows: $25K to Cancer Research via BofA CA, $25K to Mind Education and Research via UBI Banca Italy, $125K to MIT via BofA, $50K to Wellness Institute, $150K to The New School, $15K to International Friends of the Elton, $50K to International Police and Fire Chapel via BofA, $100K checks. Black 'felt comfortable making this donation because he understood that Epstein was a strong proponent of scientific innovation.' Separately, a letter from Gratitude America to Black dated August 21, 2015 thanked him for a $5 million donation (confirmed by email from Epstein to Black), but Dechert found no bank record or Family Office document confirming this $5M payment. This suggests Black donated $10M-$15M to Gratitude America in 2015 alone. Gratitude America 2015 990-PF shows $10,007,332 revenue. Dechert also noted Black made donations at Epstein's request to MIT, Harvard, Arizona State Origins Project, and Peace Initiative Foundation.

Brockman+Matson run Edge Foundation. Cwerman runs HDI with Mark Epstein on board. Apollo executives Hannan+Cohen on Black Foundation board. (5) KEY DATES: Black $10M to Gratitude (Oct 2015). Gratitude $1.26M grants (2017). Gratitude $891K grants (2018). HDI flagged for excess benefit transaction (2015). Edge Foundation received $35K from Gratitude (2018) while itself making zero grants.

The 'Coutts PETER' payments in DS10 are identified as a $15,000 grant from Gratitude America, Ltd to Peter Fenwick (British neuropsychiatrist) at Coutts and Co. on February 21, 2017. The bank statement (EFTA01296855, Gratitude America account Jan-Jun 2017) shows: 'TO COUTTS AND CO. A/C PETER FENWICK' for $15,000. Network, 2. La Laguna (without Goldsmiths), 3. Pay to me and I will administer grant. But I am not a charity.'). The grant was routed through Gratitude America, Epstein's Leon Black-funded charity vehicle at Deutsche Bank. This represents Epstein funding consciousness research through his charity infrastructure.

BV70 LLC was an entity owned by Leon Black used to make two loans to Epstein's Plan D LLC: $22.5M on 3/31/2017 and $8M on 4/17/2017, totaling $30.5M. Listed as 'NC' (not a charity) on 990-PF — not a US 501(c)(3). Address: Via Tuscolana 1000, Rome, Italy. Run by Professor Giuseppe Bersani of Sapienza University Rome. Bersani requested EUR 15,000 for Cuba congress budget deficit, providing Italian IBAN. Pattern: Epstein used Gratitude America to fund a non-US entity with no 501(c)(3) status, organizing events in Cuba during US embargo period, channeled through personal academic contacts.

The project represented Epstein's attempt to create a PBS-branded science series where he would have creative influence over participant selection and episode topics, effectively laundering his reputation through association with Nobel laureates and leading scientists.

Black wrote formal letter (Dec 2014) about the Origins Project. Epstein was independently a donor (separate from Black). Joi Ito confirmed MIT was able to keep Leon Black money but had to bounce $25K from Epstein's foundation back to ASU.

KPMG forensic review (Dec 18, 2020) confirmed exactly 5 donations to IPI totaling $650,000 from Epstein-controlled entities between 2010-2020: (1) Enhanced Education $125,000 on Oct 11, 2011 for 'WK Rick Hooper fellowship'; (2) Gratitude America $150,000 on May 8, 2017 labeled 'Reimbursement of tickets to the Oslo Play'; (3) Gratitude America $125,000 on Jun 12, 2017; (4) Gratitude America $100,000 on Nov 1, 2017 labeled 'Contribution from Gatitude [sic] America, LTD Oslo Play'; (5) Gratitude America $150,000 on Apr 5, 2019 (3 months before arrest). KPMG also found one flight reimbursement of $14,158.88 from Enhanced Education on Mar 28, 2014 for 'L. Summers flight'. Total Epstein-related financial flow through IPI: $664,158.88.

The 'Oslo Play' was used as justification for $250,000 in payments from Gratitude America to IPI in 2017. Two checks totaling $250K: $150K on May 8, 2017 ('Reimbursement of tickets to the Oslo Play') and $100K on Nov 1, 2017 ('Contribution from Gatitude America, LTD Oslo Play'). The Broadway play 'Oslo' by J.T. Rogers premiered at Lincoln Center in June 2016 and transferred to Broadway in April 2017. Rod-Larsen hosted a private cocktail reception before a May 5, 2017 performance (EFTA02650430). Epstein 'hired out the entire theatre for the U.N.' (EFTA02650158). However, $250K for theater tickets is wildly disproportionate. KPMG noted no donor restrictions on these contributions, meaning IPI could use the funds for any purpose. This pattern suggests the 'Oslo Play' label may have been a pretext for unrestricted charitable donations.

Leon Black donation structuring through Enhanced Education: In Dec 2014, Epstein told Rich Joslin/Richard Kahn that Leon Black would donate $10.5M to Enhanced Education. In Oct 2015, the plan was refined: $4.75M to J Epstein Virgin Islands Foundation Inc, with Black's automotive LLC as the paying entity. Richard Kahn explicitly stated: 'In an effort to avoid public disclosure of Leon name this charitable donation should be paid from your LLC that owns automobiles. Since automotive LLC is a single member LLC it will be the equivalent of Leon making charitable donation on will be reported on his 2015 Form 1040.' This demonstrates Enhanced Education was deliberately used as a vehicle to obscure the connection between donors and Epstein.

Epstein forwarded IPI bank wiring instructions to Boris Nikolic (Bill Gates science advisor) on June 10, 2013, with the note: 'These are the wiring instructions for the 5 million from the foundatoin. for IPI.' IPI banked at JPMorgan Chase, Branch 292, 1 United Nations Plaza, New York, NY 10017. Account: International Peace Institute, ABA 021-000021, SWIFT CHASUS-33. The $5M reference indicates Epstein was brokering a major donation from the Gates Foundation to IPI. This is confirmed by the Gates Foundation grant agreement (OPP1096058) that Rod-Larsen forwarded to Epstein on March 3, 2014, and the September 11, 2013 meeting agenda at Gates Foundation campus between IPI and BMGF staff.

KPMG confirmed Enhanced Education made one donation to IPI of $125,000 on Oct 11, 2011, recorded as 'Enhanced Education funding for WK Rick Hooper fellowship.' Additionally, Enhanced Education reimbursed IPI $14,158.88 on March 28, 2014 for Lawrence Summers's first-class flight (recorded as 'Enhanced Education reimbursement for L. Summers flight'). This was a flight to Almaty, Kazakhstan, arranged by Bella Klein via Protravel Intl. The total confirmed flow from Enhanced Education to IPI was $139,158.88.

Leon Black donated $200,000 to IPI in December 2014. The donation letter (EFTA02705181) from Black at 760 Park Avenue was addressed to 'Terje Rod-Larsen, President, International Peace Institute, Inc., 777 United Nations Plaza 4th Floor, New York, NY 10017-3521.' This donation was separate from Black's $10M to Gratitude America (Oct 2015), which subsequently made its own donations to IPI. The letter refers to 'the excellent work being done at International Peace Institute Inc.' Richard Kahn (Epstein's accountant) tracked this alongside Black's other charitable giving directed by Epstein: 'Leon 2014 year end charities along with fees 2013-2015' (EFTA02465679). Kahn noted he forgot to include 'the 10,000,000 to g[ratitude America]' in the email.

Enhanced Education funded the ASU Origins Project at Arizona State University, run by Lawrence Krauss with CEO Gretchen Buhlig at ASU Foundation. In Jan 2019, emails show Enhanced Education 'authorization' was needed to transfer funds from the Origins Project to MIT Media Lab. The email thread 'ASU Origins to MIT Media Lab - Enhanced Education' (Jan-Feb 2019) discusses moving funds and includes a reference to 'the Black calculation' -- likely related to Leon Black donations routed through. Enhanced Education also funded using appreciated stock from 'sfl portfolio such as Facebook or biogen' (Aug 2014). The $100K ASU pledge listed Jeffrey Epstein c/o Rich Kahn, Enhanced Education, with preference for anonymous donation.

The April 5, 2019 donation of $150,000 from Gratitude America to IPI -- just 3 months before Epstein's July 6 arrest -- was facilitated by Bella Klein (Epstein's accounting staff). On April 4, 2019, Klein emailed Camilla Reksten-Monsen (Rod-Larsen's special assistant at IPI) requesting IPI bank instructions and 501c3 certification. Reksten-Monsen provided IPI's JPMorgan Chase account details. Klein responded: 'I will send check tomorrow AM' to IPI's offices at 777 UN Plaza (EFTA02282103). Klein preferred to 'send an overnight check or deliver check via messenger' rather than wire (EFTA02280923). This was the last Epstein-related donation to IPI. The timing -- April 2019, with SDNY investigation already underway -- raises questions about whether this was a final disbursement before anticipated legal proceedings.

Education Advance (www.educationadvances.org) is a SEPARATE entity from Enhanced Education, though both are Epstein-controlled. Education Advance was founded in 2016, focused on 'increasing diversity in the American education system by supporting minority groups through the college application process' and promoting STEM education. It made donations including: $50K to PRAJNOPAYA Institute (Buddhist retreat), $55K reported by Daily Beast (which was to be returned after Epstein allegations surfaced), and payments through TestBest. An employee asked whether salary should come from TestBest or Education Advance. CT Corp handled its Delaware filing ($575.60 invoice, May 2017). Epstein explicitly listed Enhanced Education and Education Advance as separate payment options. The entity was linked to Joi Ito / MIT Media Lab.

Epstein treated IPI as part of his personal financial architecture, listing it alongside his trusts, Harvard donations, and consulting fees in an April 14, 2015 estate planning email: '7 estate modification given new circunstances and altered probablities. (use etc) 8 charity, new trusts,\!\!d IPI, harvard, fees.' The email was sent to an advisor referred to as 'brad' who was 'desperate for help.' This placement of IPI alongside 'estate modification' and 'new trusts' suggests Epstein viewed his IPI donations not as philanthropy but as components of a broader financial strategy. The total Epstein-directed financial flow to IPI includes: direct donations 650K, Enhanced Education flight reimbursement 14K, Leon Black donation 200K (directed by Epstein per Kahn emails), and the brokered 5M Gates Foundation grant -- making Epstein responsible for approximately 5.86M or more in IPI funding.

Landon Thomas Jr (NYT financial reporter, landont@nytimes.com, personal: landonthomasjr63@gmail.com) maintained 185-email correspondence with Jeffrey Epstein spanning 2007-2019. Thomas wrote the 2002 New York Magazine profile that became the defining piece on Epstein. Post-conviction, Thomas pitched an NYT interview allowing Epstein to define the story on your terms. The relationship was deeply reciprocal: Thomas provided advance intelligence on journalists investigating Epstein, market analysis, and Wall Street gossip. Epstein provided tips, access to billionaires for stories, and directed a 30K donation to Thomas charity. Thomas phone: 212-556-3821 (NYT), 917-794-6902 (mobile).

Summers asked Epstein for financial advice on cryptocurrency tax avoidance (Jan 8, 2018). Summers wrote: 'This is for me in a minor way and for a pal in a major way. Suppose u own say 1 percent of a company with crypto currency worth a billion. Restrictions of various kinds on ability to sell. Will a charity take it and give u a reasonable valuation. Can u advantageously set up a foundation and donate it? Other schemes.' (EFTA02540589). This shows a former Treasury Secretary consulting a convicted sex offender on tax avoidance strategies for cryptocurrency holdings, asking about charitable donation schemes to avoid restrictions on selling. The 'pal in a major way' suggests Summers was seeking this advice on behalf of a billionaire crypto holder in his network.

Oct 2015 Black-Epstein payment of $19.75M split: $15M to Southern Trust Company (Deutsche Bank acct 44129244) via Black Family Partners-0135, and $4.75M to J Epstein VI Foundation via automotive LLC to avoid public disclosure of Leon's name. Richard Kahn directed Brad Wechsler (Black's office) on routing. Automotive LLC was single-member LLC owned by Black for automobile purchases, used as pass-through to make the $4.75M appear as charitable donation on Black's 2015 Form 1040. Entity lacked cash so required loan from Leon Black-0945 or LDB 2014 LLC-8991. Wire to Pershing LLC (Bank of NY) acct 890-51238-4, then to J Epstein VI Foundation acct N4G024950.

Feb 1, 2019: Epstein personally emailed Brad Edwards confirming a check FedExed from Enhanced Education. Edwards had requested on Jan 24, 2019 a 'foundation donation' to National Crime Victim Bar Association (3434 North Washington Blvd, Suite 1100, Arlington VA 22201). Epstein confirmed it was 'put on the jan giving list' and 'actually gets sent today.' Same day Epstein also sent separate email confirming FedEx delivery from Enhanced Education. This is Epstein's foundation paying for a donation to a victim advocacy organization at the request of Edwards, the attorney who represented Epstein's victims and had settled with Epstein in Dec 2018.

Enhanced Education (J Epstein VI Foundation) Jan 2019: Richard Kahn authorized transfer of $467,150 related to Leon Black from Enhanced Education to ASU Foundation for Origins Project/MIT Media Lab. Epstein understood amount should be closer to $500K. Gretchen Buhlig (CEO, ASU Foundation) confirmed receiving 'Enhanced Education authorization' and would 'send the Black calculation.' This shows Enhanced Education was still actively disbursing funds from Black-sourced money as late as Jan 2019. Amount appears derived from a Black donation tracked separately as 'Black calculation.'

Edwards and Epstein negotiated directly without lawyers, with a remarkably collegial tone. Edwards: 'Without lawyers, we can get things done. Impossible once you bring in the opinions of a bunch of lawyers.' Epstein to Edwards: 'you and I get along better than others.' The settlement included: (1) a public apology from Epstein admitting his lawsuit was 'my unreasonable attempt to damage Edwards's business reputation,' (2) payment of Edwards's legal costs, and (3) Epstein's donation to National Crime Victim Bar Association at Edwards's request (Jan-Feb 2019). Epstein's lawyer Martin Weinberg ('Marty') objected that apology language could constitute 'admission of a crime.' Epstein sought to modify 'absolutely false allegations' to protect a separate case against Fowler White Burnett.

Edge Foundation Inc (EIN 13-3528667, 260 Fifth Ave 10th Floor, New York) received at least 638K from Epstein-linked foundations between 1999-2015, comprising over 74% of its total revenue in that period. Run by literary agent John Brockman, Edge hosted billionaires dinners that gave Epstein access to elite scientists and tech founders. Revenue peaked at 316K in 2015 (Epsteins last donation year), then collapsed -- 6K by 2023. Gratitude America paid 35K to Edge Foundation. DOJ corpus contains 20+ Brockman-Epstein emails.

J. Epstein Virgin Islands Foundation Inc (aka Enhanced Education) is a 501(c)(3) USVI private foundation at 6100 Red Hook Quarter B3, St Thomas USVI. Accounts at JPMorgan, Deutsche Bank (account opened with Cagnetta), and First Bank VI. Southern Trust Company Inc operates under its corporate umbrella and sponsored the St Thomas-St John STEM Fair. Brad Wechsler confirmed 501(c)(3) status when moving donations (Oct 2015). QuickBooks register shows payments to Stockholm School of Economics (Sept 2008). Foundation sent wire instructions to Richard Kahn at HBRK Associates, 575 Lexington Ave 4th Floor NYC. The unanimous consent (EFTA01298338) confirms identity: J. EPSTEIN VIRGIN ISLANDS FOUNDATION INC d/b/a ENHANCED EDUCATION. Enhanced Education was the OPAQUE disbursement vehicle not subject to public disclosure. It funded Lawrence Krauss's Origins Project at ASU, paid for Summers's first-class flights, and channeled $467,150 from Leon Black.

Kahn managed Gratitude America as its President, handling all disbursements. Key operations: coordinated with Deutsche Bank on SFL/Gratitude America accounts (March 2016, classified Strictly Confidential). Set up AG account with higher interest (Aug 2018). Directed Gratitude America donations including to James Fitzpatrick (April 2018 - check sent via regular mail). Managed Gratitude America stationery for recommendation letters. Coordinated LNKD stock sales (sold 800 at 192.22) and WDC bond purchases (2MM at 104.30) through Epstein accounts.

Debra and Leon Black Family Foundation (EIN 13-3947890) at 445 Park Ave, c/o Elysium. Revenue pattern shows massive spike in 2014 (.1M received, .08M in gifts, .76M in grants paid) - this is the year M to Gratitude America was likely routed. 2015: .6M revenue, .1M expenses. 2019: .82M revenue, all from gifts (.815M), .81M in grants paid - last significant year. Post-2020: assets collapsed to under K, revenue near zero. The foundation was essentially a pass-through vehicle for Black donations.

Epstein donated 50,000 dollars to the UJA-Federation Wall Street Dinner honoring Howard Lutnick in December 2017. Epstein emailed John Paulson: '50k from me, hope pr is ok' (EFTA02568209). UJA staff wrote to Epstein: 'many thanks for your incredible donation in honor of Howard Lutnick' and asked if he wanted a commemorative journal ad and table for 10. Epstein's assistant also confirmed to Lutnick's staff: 'Jeffrey says he will not use the table himself and to pass along to Lutnick he can fill them\!' This was a post-conviction financial gesture directly benefiting Lutnick's reputation.

Epstein advised Reid Hoffman on tax-free stock donation via CRT (Charitable Remainder Trust) in the context of a corporate inversion: 'trust (CRT), where the stock can be sold on a tax-free basis... To avoid this result, it is best to make the donation of stock before shareholder approval of the inversion occurs' (Jul 26, 2016, EFTA02456896). This confirms Epstein was simultaneously advising multiple billionaires on inversion-related tax strategies during the same period he was advising Rowan on Apollo's inversion. The expertise was not hypothetical -- it was an active advisory practice.

Epstein asked Summers in November 2014 if 'Harvard ok with donation?' — Summers replied 'Let's talk.' This confirms Epstein was actively pursuing a donation to Harvard through Summers as intermediary, AFTER his 2008 conviction. Harvard publicly acknowledged receiving $6.5M from Epstein between 1998-2007 (pre-conviction) but this 2014 exchange suggests additional post-conviction donation attempts may have been brokered through Summers. The exchange occurred while Summers was Harvard University Professor and President Emeritus.

IPI financial trajectory mapped from ProPublica 990 filings (2005-2023): Peak revenue $11.87M (2014) declining to $5.04M (2023). Peak assets $16.37M (2014) declining to $6.91M (2023). Post-Epstein arrest (2019): Revenue $9.33M, expenses $10.09M — already deficit spending. COVID year (2020): Revenue collapsed to $3.93M while expenses remained $7.62M — $3.7M deficit. Recovery (2021): Revenue spike to $10.77M. Steady decline since: $6.66M (2022), $5.04M (2023). KPMG confirmed $650K in Epstein-related donations (2010-2020) plus $14,158.88 Summers flight reimbursement. IPI lost approximately 58% of its asset base from peak ($16.37M → $6.91M) over the period, with the steepest drops coinciding with the Epstein scandal and Rod-Larsen's departure. The organization continues operating at 777 UN Plaza but at dramatically reduced scale.

Dechert LLP investigation report (Apollo 8-K, 2021-01-25) confirms Leon Black donated $10 million to Gratitude America in October 2015 -- described as 'a charitable organization affiliated with Epstein.' Black 'felt comfortable making this donation because he understood that Epstein was a strong proponent of scientific innovation.' Separately, a letter from Gratitude America to Black dated August 21, 2015 thanked him for a $5 million donation (confirmed by email from Epstein to Black), but Dechert found no bank record or Family Office document confirming this $5M payment. This suggests Black donated $10M-$15M to Gratitude America in 2015 alone. Gratitude America 2015 990-PF shows $10,007,332 revenue. Dechert also noted Black made donations at Epstein's request to MIT, Harvard, Arizona State Origins Project, and Peace Initiative Foundation.

Joi Ito (MIT Media Lab director) introduced Iozzo to Epstein via email on May 6, 2014. Ito described Iozzo as 'one of the best network security guys I know' and said he was 'working with him on a network security company idea' that 'might be interesting for you as well.' Iozzo met Epstein on May 18, 2014. This is the same Joi Ito who invested Epstein money in Blockstream (500K allocation, EFTA01918921) and who resigned from MIT in 2019 over Epstein donations. The 'network security company idea' Ito referenced likely became Iperlane (founded 2015).

Iozzo was Research Affiliate at MIT Media Lab 2016-2020, the same institution directed by Joi Ito who introduced him to Epstein. This deepens the Ito-Iozzo-Epstein triangle: Ito introduced them in 2014 pitching a security company, Iozzo then held an official MIT Media Lab affiliation while his company Iperlane was funded (allegedly by Epstein as one of three billionaire backers), and Ito simultaneously channeled Epstein donations to MIT. Ito resigned from MIT in Aug 2019 when this was exposed. Also connected to Andrew McAfee via Epstein email network per EpsteinWeb tracker.

SYNTHESIS: Iozzo served three distinct roles for Epstein across 4.5 years (May 2014-Dec 2018): (1) cybersecurity/surveillance advisor — provided iOS vulnerability intelligence, built IperLane GPS people-tracking tool, assessed crypto wallet security; (2) technology broker — Epstein forwarded Iozzo's Mycelium wallet analysis to a Russian contact (Moscow timezone) offering 'I will do anything helpful to you,' and pitched IperLane to Apollo/Leon Black; (3) deal-flow intermediary — channeled Blocktree Capital (Ben Forman/ParaFi) investments to Epstein including Grab Series H (.25B), Radius Intelligence (M), and Bitmain. Introduced by Joi Ito (MIT Media Lab), Iozzo held MIT Research Affiliate status 2016-2020 while Ito channeled Epstein donations. Jun 30, 2017 schedule places Iozzo (10am), Ito (3:30pm), and Barak (arrived prior day) at 9 E 71st within 24 hours — converging cyber, academia/tech, and defense/intelligence. Complete legal vacuum: zero prosecutions despite FBI CHS claims of zero-day sales to Hezbollah, Saudi Arabia, GCHQ, and money laundering via California theater company. Current entity: IRD Holdings Corp (CIK 0001916133, DE, .19M raised 2022-2025) / SlashID (cybersecurity startup). 77 unique EFTA documents confirm sustained engagement; Iozzo was the persistent initiator throughout.

Siegel introduced Epstein to Catherine Lurie-Alt (London-based). April 4 2013 email from Siegel: Great to see you today. I happened to get a call from Catherine Alt (Lurie) after I got back and I told her I just saw you and how great you are etc and she is in LA tonight and tomorrow and hopes you will call to say hello. Catherine Alt had her own independent relationship with Epstein - thanked him for a donation (Apr 7 2013), met for breakfast in NYC (Oct 2013), New Year wishes. She cc'd both Siegel and Epstein on emails.

Catherine Lurie-Alt identified: London-based journalist, filmmaker, producer. European Correspondent for JBS (Jewish Broadcasting Service) TV. Member of Foreign Press Association. UK member of European Jewish Parliament. Board of Trustees of Maccabi World Union. Director/producer of Back to Berlin documentary (2018) about Jewish bikers carrying Maccabi Games torch Israel to Berlin. Runs Luria Media Limited. Known to both Bill Siegel and Jeffrey Epstein. Had independent email relationship with Epstein including receiving a donation from him (Apr 2013), NYC breakfast meetings (Oct 2013), cc on emails with both men.

EFTA01297950 contains what appears to be a web search results page with query 'Erika Kellerhals AND allegation OR arrest OR bribe OR convict OR corrupt OR court' -- standard due diligence search. C.O.U.Q. Foundation $75K donation to Dalton School: Epstein's tax-exempt C.O.U.Q. Foundation made a $75,000 donation to The Dalton School several weeks BEFORE Vicky Ward's Vanity Fair profile was published (March 2003). This is consistent with Epstein's pattern of using charitable donations as leverage/narrative control. Ward's profile was being preempted: Landon Thomas Jr.'s friendly New York Magazine profile ('Jeffrey Epstein: International Moneyman of Mystery') was rushed out October 28, 2002 — months ahead of Ward. Ward had uncovered connection to Ponzi scheme, securities law violations, and (excised from final story) on-the-record sexual abuse accounts from Maria and Annie Farmer. Per Thomas Volscho.

House Oversight Nov 2025 release includes 2015 email exchange with Epstein exchanging tips re Trump and photos. Volscho characterizes Thomas as one of several reporters with whom Epstein had transactional/collusion-style relationships — something elite sex traffickers have that ordinary offenders do not. NY Mag profile contained signalling phrases like Russian ladies of the night sourced from Maxwell friends.

LITTLESIS NETWORK MAP (entity 254763): Positions -- SDNY US Attorney (current), Apollo Lead Independent Director (2021-02-18), SEC Chairman, Sullivan+Cromwell Partner. Kirkland & Ellis LLP is the world's highest-grossing law firm with the most consequential DOJ revolving door. LittleSis maps 131 relationships (107 positions, 10 business, 7 donations, 5 lobbying). At least 22 confirmed K&E alumni held senior government positions across 4 administrations. The firm represented Jeffrey Epstein in his 2008 federal case through partner Jay Lefkowitz, who negotiated the favorable plea deal with former K&E associate Alexander Acosta (then US Attorney).

K&E Major Corporate Client Network (LittleSis confirmed): Caterpillar Inc., General Motors (1999-2005), Coca-Cola (2005-2008), Boeing (737 MAX DPA), BP (Deepwater Horizon), Volkswagen (emissions scandal), Cerberus Capital Management, Goldman Sachs (1MDB case via Filip), FMC Corporation (1999), Hillshire Brands (1999-2002), Briggs & Stratton (2003-2006), Commonwealth of Puerto Rico, Seneca Resources Corporation, Bullish. Deutsche Bank retained K&E for CFTC precious metals spoofing settlement ($30M), shareholder litigation following forex investigation, and MidOcean Partners spin-off. 2016 revenue spike to $25.5M explained: 317 noncash contributions of publicly traded securities worth $11.3M (average stock price valuation) plus $14.2M cash. Most surplus went to temporarily restricted net assets ($6.2M→$18.6M). Grants that year were only $11.9M to 321 orgs. The restricted funds released in 2017 when grants jumped to $14.6M on only $9.6M revenue. Pattern: K&E partners make stock donations to Foundation which distributes as matching gifts.

In US v. Epstein (96 CIV 8307, SDNY 1998), the US Government sued to evict Epstein from a building formerly used as the residence of the Deputy Consul General of Iran. After diplomatic relations were severed in 1980, OFM leased the building to Epstein in 1992. Epstein sublet it to attorney Ivan S. Fisher in 1996 without consent. Government terminated Epsteins lease and sought ejectment plus back rent. Epstein was represented by Wachtel & Masyr LLP (Steven J. Cohen). Judge Chin presided.

Ivan S. Fisher was one of NYC's most prominent criminal defense attorneys in the 1980s-90s. Top 5 criminal attorney per NYT in 1980. Lead counsel in the Pizza Connection Trial (longest federal criminal trial at the time) and French Connection cases. Lectured at Yale Law and Columbia Law. Fisher sublet 34 E 69th from Epstein at $20K/month starting May 7, 1996. He turned the former Iranian diplomatic residence into a multi-occupant law office complex housing at least 3 separate practices. Fisher was subsequently BANNED from practicing in federal court in SDNY in 2013 after stealing money from a client.
